Name: Singleplayer sleep
Author: MindMeltMax
Description:
[size=4][b]Description : 
[/b][/size]Gives you the abillity to restore stamina and health while laying in bed, just like in multiplayer.
Just hop into bed or onto a chair.

[b]Compatible with 1.5[/b]

[size=4][b]Installation : 
[/b][/size]1. Install [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]Smapi[/url]﻿
2. Unzip file and place in mod folder
3. Good Night!

[size=3][b]Update 1.2.0 : 
[/b][/size]The Mod is now updated to allow for regen while sitting.
This should have come out right after the 1.5 update but my motivation was lower than my self-esteem
